status: offline only; no activation, database writes or production deployment
outlier_rule: one-pass Tukey fences from all eligible available training labels before fitting; shared by every candidate; never based on prediction errors
outlier_definition: below Q1 - 1.5*max(IQR,1) or above Q3 + 1.5*max(IQR,1); bounds inclusive; raw records retained
primary_availability: preceding_day: observed_at and created_at both strictly before prediction date's local midnight
secondary_availability: entry_time: observed_at and created_at both strictly before prediction observed_at; initial entry time only, later edits not reconstructed
test_quality: strict and minute_approximation always scored separately
primary_group: three systems, strict-only training, preceding-day availability, strict validation rows
primary_score: normal-label hit count / normal-label predicted count for absolute error <= 1 pp; also all-label score, per-date score, exclusions, skipped coverage, MAE, median and 90th-percentile error
selection: select among learned candidates using primary selection dates only: highest normal hit1 fraction, then lower normal MAE, then declared model order; never select using later replay
two_system_baseline: level>=30 gives14, otherwise15; two-system results never merged into primary, no winner selected there
recent_order: latest observed_at among eligible available clean training rows within 24h of the prediction; not latest entry; median fallback if none, bias shrunk by n/(n+2); no future or same-target label
majority_fit: Huber level slope plus intercept shift maximizing training residual coverage within +/-1; constant mode baseline uses same densest-width2 rule; ties by all-clean-training MAE then distance to median then center
no_search: no hyperparameter grid, clustering, dynamic lag search, polynomial search or test-label-based filtering
frozen_selection: algorithm selected before later replay; coefficients may refit using earlier available labels during replay as declared; no retuning from replay errors
normal_subset_caveat: validation labels define normal membership after prediction; unknown label status is not available to live predictions; report all-label performance beside conditional normal scores
alignment_caveat: retain prior t-90s matching on received_at, age<=30s for level; source timestamps differ and physical alignment is not independently verified
prior_data_use: all these historical data and previous tail have already been inspected; all new metrics are exploratory historical replay, not independent prospective validation
outputs: fitted candidates, fold bounds/IDs, each prediction and its error, excluded and skipped records, scores and plots; no production model registry writes
